Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Micron’s Storage and Memory Systems Pathfinding team explores how emerging AI workloads are reshaping the future of memory, storage, and heterogeneous computing. We work across software and hardware boundaries to identify new system opportunities and turn forward-looking concepts into measurable, practical innovations.

In this role, you will help shape next-generation AI infrastructure by architecting and optimizing inference software stacks and collaborating closely with hardware teams on hardware/software co-design. You will lead technical initiatives, build proof-of-concept solutions, evaluate emerging technologies, and influence platform capabilities before hardware is available.

Responsibilities:

Architect and optimize AI inference software stacks to enable proof-of-concept hardware capabilities and quantify the value of proposed system features
Lead software development and technical initiatives independently and with small teams, partnering with hardware teams on system architecture and hardware/software co-design
Develop Linux applications, libraries, and emulation solutions for heterogeneous computing systems using C, C++, Python, Rust, CUDA, SYCL, or related technologies
Research emerging AI software and system architectures, identifying memory, storage, performance, and scalability opportunities
Debug sophisticated system-level issues, collaborate across organizations and external partners, mentor engineers, and communicate technical findings to collaborators

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with 10+ years of relevant experience, or PhD with 7+ years of relevant experience, in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
Hands-on experience across multiple layers of end-to-end AI inference software stacks, such as frameworks, inference engines, ML compilers, compiler infrastructure, hardware runtimes, or hardware abstraction layers
Proficiency in C, C++, and Python development on Linux, including experience with multithreading, IPC, ioctl, GDB, /proc, and /sys
Experience programming GPUs or other accelerators using CUDA, SYCL, OpenCL, or a comparable model, with solid understanding of heterogeneous compute architectures, memory hierarchies, NUMA, caching, and high-speed interconnects
Experience debugging across applications, libraries, operating systems, kernels, networks, and hardware/software interfaces, with demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives without supervisory authority

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with LLM serving internals, including KV-cache management and offloading, Prefill and decode phases, and disaggregated serving
Experience with inference engines or distributed serving frameworks such as SGLang, vLLM, NVIDIA Dynamo, or TensorRT-LLM
Technical leadership experience in a systems-focused pathfinding, advanced development, or research organization
Knowledge of HBM, DRAM, emerging memory technologies, NVMe SSDs, NAND, and next-generation storage architectures
